label: Text 1
transcript: Naima's class is mapping the litter on a 200-metre stretch of street outside the school. They are using a clipboard, a tally chart, and one rather reluctant volunteer who brought gloves. After three days they have 412 plastic items, 201 paper items, and one extremely confused fox who wants to know what they're doing.
